body:
> Is it possible to implement dynamic loading for levels? That is, loading the resources corresponding to the current level only when the player enters it.
If Level A and Level B share models or files, is there a way to avoid reloading these shared resources to further optimize the package size?

Yes to both, by exporting parts of the game data as [separate PCK files](https://docs.godotengine.org/en/latest/tutorials/export/exporting_pcks.html) that you load in the menus or during gameplay using [HTTP requests](https://docs.godotengine.org/en/stable/tutorials/networking/http_request_class.html). There are plans to make this process more seamless in the future, but nothing is set in stone yet.

Closing, as this issue tracker is meant to be used for bug reports only. For support questions, use one of the other [community channels](https://godotengine.org/community) instead.
